items.text: Each news item is marked up as an article element with a time element, giving seven articles and seven times.
items.evidence: tag_counts article 7, time 7, h3 7

items.text: The heading outline is shallow and in order: one h1, one h2 section label, seven h3 article titles and two h4 footer labels.
items.evidence: heading_outline: h1, h2 'LATEST NEWS', 7 h3, h4 'FOLLOW US', h4 'LINKS'

items.text: A saturated red is the single accent colour, used for the date badge, the 'FEATURED NEWS' tag, the 'LATEST NEWS' label and the 'READ MORE' links.
items.evidence: rgb(228,0,43) appears as a background twice and as a text colour 8 times; red elements are visible in both slices

items.text: Secondary text, such as dates and the footer copy, uses a muted grey-blue.
items.evidence: text colour rgb(154,160,173) appears 31 times; grey dates such as 'Feb 13, 2020' are visible

items.text: The news cards sit on a slightly lighter charcoal surface than the page background.
items.evidence: background rgb(24,26,31) appears 7 times; the cards appear as dark grey panels with thin borders

items.text: The entire page uses a system font stack, with no web fonts.
items.evidence: fonts_by_element_count: system-ui 209; h1 font-family 'system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif'

items.text: The h1 is very large and bold: 67.2px against a 16px body size, a ratio of about 4.2x.
items.evidence: h1 font_size 67.2px, weight 700; body_font_size 16px

items.text: The h2 is small (14px bold), uppercase and letter-spaced, so it reads as an eyebrow label rather than a large heading.
items.evidence: h2 font_size 14px, weight 700; 'LATEST NEWS' is visible as small spaced red caps

items.text: Navigation items, badges, 'READ MORE' links and footer h4 labels share a style: uppercase, bold and widely tracked.
items.evidence: nav 'HOME NEWS VIDEO…', 'FEATURED NEWS', 'READ MORE →' and 'FOLLOW US' are all visible as spaced caps

items.text: Body line height is 1.5x the font size.
items.evidence: body_line_height 24px with body_font_size 16px

items.text: Article headlines are in sentence case and bold, which sets them apart from the all-caps UI labels.
items.evidence: h3 text such as 'Pepper beats housemate to Bathurst honour' is visible in bold sentence case

items.text: The header is a dark horizontal bar with a small logo on the left, a row of 10 uppercase links, and circular social icons on the right.
items.evidence: headerlogo.png rendered 34x44 at x136; nav links from HOME to BUSHFIRES APPEAL; Facebook and Twitter circles at the top right

items.text: The header background is slightly translucent and has a backdrop blur.
items.evidence: background rgba(14,15,18,0.95) appears once; effects.backdrop_blur 1

items.text: The hero has a dark carbon-fibre texture with red and blue diagonal shards in the upper right; this is visual decoration, not an img element.
items.evidence: slice 0 hero shows a woven texture and a red/blue angled wedge; gradient_backgrounds 0 and no hero image in the images list

items.text: The hero date badge is a non-interactive label styled as a sharp-cornered red block.
items.evidence: buttons count 1 (the Menu button); the date badge is visible with square corners

items.text: The featured card puts a 'FEATURED NEWS' tag above the headline, followed by the date, text links 'Share on Facebook' and 'Tweet', and a 'READ MORE →' link pinned near the bottom of the panel.
items.evidence: slice 0 featured card content; READ MORE sits near the bottom of the card at about y=1011

items.text: Each grid card follows the same order: image on top, then the bold title, the grey date and a red 'READ MORE →' link.
items.evidence: slice 1 shows the same structure in all six cards

items.text: Article thumbnails are cropped to a uniform landscape box whatever their source size.
items.evidence: Bushfireappeal.jpg natural 2500x1683 and M20-fine.jpg natural 385x305 both render at 374x234

items.text: The page repeats the same imagery: the featured photo of the cars on the grid appears again as the third thumbnail in the grid.
items.evidence: Bath12Hr-MH3.jpg and Bath12Hr-MH3_2.jpg show the same scene in slice 0; file names MH1.jpg and MH1_2.jpg suggest another duplicate pair

items.text: Article images have empty alt text, while sponsor logos have descriptive alt text.
items.evidence: Bath12Hr-MH3.jpg alt '', Bushfireappeal.jpg alt ''; LiquiMoly.png alt 'Liqui Moly', Pirelli.png alt 'Pirelli'; alt_missing 0

items.text: Corner radii are mostly 0, with a minority of small radii and a few pill or circle shapes.
items.evidence: border_radius_buckets: 0 → 179, 1–7 → 26, 8–15 → 0, 16+ → 0, pill → 4; primary_button radius 6px

items.text: The circle shapes are the outlined social icon buttons, which appear in both the header and the footer.
items.evidence: bucket_pill 4; svgs 4 and paths 4; Facebook and Twitter circles in the header (slice 0) and footer (slice 1)

items.text: Motion is limited to transitions: there are no keyframe animations or transforms.
items.evidence: transitions 40, animations 0, transforms 0

items.text: The page uses no gradients and no shadows, so depth comes only from flat colour steps between near-black tones.
items.evidence: gradient_backgrounds 0, box_shadows 0; backgrounds rgb(14,15,18), rgb(24,26,31) and rgb(8,9,11)

items.text: The 'Menu' button is transparent with off-white text, 6px radius and 8px 12px padding, and is not visible in the desktop rendering.
items.evidence: primary_button: text 'Menu', bg rgba(0,0,0,0), radius 6px, padding 8px 12px; slice 0 shows no Menu button

items.text: The footer is separated from the content by a horizontal rule and opens with a two-column block: 'FOLLOW US' with copy and social icons, and 'LINKS' with four text links.
items.evidence: slice 1: divider above the footer; 'FOLLOW US' on the left and 'LINKS' (Contacts, Media, Privacy Policy, Terms & Conditions) at about x=736

items.text: The sponsor logos sit in a 9-column grid of white rectangles with small rounded corners, each logo 100x60px.
items.evidence: logo rects at x 146, 277 … 1194 with w100 h60; rows at y2160, 2238 and 2316; white rgb(255,255,255) backgrounds appear 26 times

items.text: Most sponsor logos are close to invisible on their white tiles, so many tiles look empty; only a 'McLaren' text label and the faint Pirelli, AMG, Audi Sport, Porsche and Fox Sports marks can be made out.
items.evidence: slice 1 sponsor grid: most white tiles show nothing legible

items.text: One sponsor tile shows the text 'McLaren', but no McLaren image appears in the images list.
items.evidence: a 'McLaren' text tile is visible in row 2; the images list has 31 logos with no McLaren entry, and the tile at x=408 in row 2 is missing fro

items.text: The footer copyright year (2021) and the latest article date (Oct 19, 2020) are later than the event dates shown in the hero (Jan–Feb 2020).
items.evidence: hero '31 JANUARY – 2 FEBRUARY 2020'; featured date 'Oct 19, 2020'; '© 2021'

items.text: The page has very little text, almost all of it headlines, labels and links, with only two paragraphs.
items.evidence: text_stats words 161; tag_counts p 2

items.text: The copy uses no emoji, exclamation marks or em dashes, though it does use hashtags such as #B12hr and #B12HR.
items.evidence: emoji 0, exclamations 0, em_dashes 0; 'via #B12hr', '#B12HR news'

items.text: Links are dense relative to text: 82 anchors against 161 words.
items.evidence: counts anchors 82, words 161

items.text: Layout relies heavily on CSS grid, with flexbox as well.
items.evidence: layout display_grid 33, display_flex 21

items.text: All styles are in a single inline style block, with no external stylesheets and only one script.
items.evidence: tag_counts style 1, stylesheets 0, scripts 1, inline_style_attrs 1

items.text: The page is titled after the event name, and the single h1 repeats that name in uppercase.
items.evidence: title 'Liqui-Moly Bathurst 12 Hour'; h1_count 1, h1 text 'LIQUI-MOLY BATHURST 12 HOUR'

items.text: The content area spans a fixed-width container from about x=136 to x=1304 on a 1440px page.
items.evidence: images start at x 136/137 and the third column ends at 929+374=1303; page_width 1440

items.text: The hero text block starts at about x=212, while the header, news grid and footer start at x=136. This creates two different left edges.
items.evidence: Screenshot: h1 left ≈212px vs logo/cards at x=136 (image rects x:136/137)

features.statement: Each news item is marked up as a semantic article element containing a time element.
Heading outline is shallow and ordered: one h1, one h2 section label, h3 item titles, h4 footer labels.
A single saturated red serves as the only accent colour for badges, tags, labels and links.
Secondary text such as dates and footer copy uses a muted grey-blue.
Palette is dark near-black tones, with cards on a slightly lighter charcoal surface than the page background.
Typography uses only a system font stack, with no web fonts.
The h1 is very large and bold, about four times the body size.
Section h2 is small, bold, uppercase and letter-spaced, reading as an eyebrow label rather than a heading.
Navigation, badges, read-more links and footer labels share an uppercase, bold, widely tracked style.
Article headlines are bold sentence case, contrasting with the all-caps UI labels.
Body text has a comfortable line height of about 1.5 times the font size.
Header is a dark bar with a small left logo, a row of uppercase links, and circular social icons on the right.
Header background is slightly translucent with a backdrop blur.
Hero uses a textured dark background with diagonal coloured shards as CSS decoration rather than an image element.
Date badge is a non-interactive sharp-cornered red block label.
Featured card stacks a tag, headline, date, share text links, and a read-more link pinned near the bottom.
Grid cards share one order: image on top, bold title, grey date, red read-more link.
Thumbnails are cropped to a uniform landscape box regardless of source size.
Article images have empty alt text while logos carry descriptive alt text.
Corners are mostly square, with few small radii and circular shapes reserved for social icon buttons.
Motion is limited to transitions, with no keyframe animations or transforms.
Footer is split from content by a rule and opens with two columns of social copy and text links.
Sponsor logos sit in a multi-column grid of uniform white rounded tiles, many nearly illegible on white.
Page has little text, mostly short headlines, labels and links, with very few paragraphs and a high link density.
Copy avoids emoji, exclamation marks and em dashes, though it uses hashtags.
Layout relies on CSS grid together with flexbox.
Styles are in a single inline style block with no external stylesheets.
Content sits in a fixed-width centred container, with the hero text indented to a different left edge.
Page title is the event name and the single h1 repeats it in uppercase.
